title: Ghent: medieval topography (contour lines)
descriptions: Ghent's elevation before present. Origin of the information: the contour lines are coming from Frans Blockmans’ work (BLOCKMANS, F., Het Gentsche stadspatriciaat tot omstreeks 1302, Antwerpen-‘s Gravenhage, 1938) and have been used since in lot of publications, notably by Ghent’s municipal service of archaeology.
